This is a replacement of the earlier infrastructure-first presentation emphasis. We retain useful deployment and CC contracts. We have not implemented or measured this adaptive loop. The talk is six main slides plus two hidden backups, about six minutes at a deliberate pace. The estimate is not a timed rehearsal.

Planned time 0:55. This is the worked example, not a completed experiment. Initial clarification establishes the question, data, success measure, cost and web permission. Before the discovery, fitting is a provisional future step. The initial executable batch only inspects authorized traces. The discovery invalidates the comparability premise. The planner should now test semantics, select comparable features or narrow the conclusion. It should not continue a scientifically inappropriate fit just because the first DAG named one. An unrelated accepted measurement can remain useful if its scope and dependencies still match. A driver choosing these steps only proves mechanics. The value demonstration requires the actual Planner to choose a useful revision.

Planned time 1:10. This diagram shows logical ownership rather than a new process per rectangle. The Planner selects research work. Existing protected binding and checks validate each invocation and decide acceptance. The lab controller owns execution authority, job lifecycle and actual resource controls, outside mutable research code. AI4R does not receive the Docker socket or controller policy writes. The controller may refuse missing resources or permissions. Accepted artifacts enter durable custody. Both the control/job record and project data survive app replacement; restart reconciles actual jobs before retry. Restore must fence the previous writer and verify backup bytes. Measurement work needs an exclusive slot or explicit co-running-load limitation.

The first profile uses one permitted Docker host, existing store, scoped jobs and a small application fixture. A VM is an optional outer profile; no VM-equivalent isolation claim follows from Compose. Each lab owns separate writable data, credentials and selected versions. Shared immutable artifacts can be explicit inputs. Application authors supply setup, ports and reset/checkpoint semantics. Stateful application commands need leases. Attached service access does not imply reset/upgrade authority. CC packages may expose several operations.

The factory authors candidates; protected qualification controls eligibility. Compatible local updates apply to future bindings, preserving running attempts and sessions. Whole-harness RSI belongs to the RSI owner. Central adoption is separate. Factory expansion, robotics, GPU and fleet automation are not prerequisites for testing the first adaptive loop.

Planned time 1:05. Replanning is selective, not after every observation. Initial rules trigger at a declared investigation boundary, changed user direction or permission, invalidated assumption, missing prerequisite, unrecoverable failure or idle work with unmet objectives. Routine findings update knowledge. A bounded periodic/no-progress review catches missed triggers, with all planning and checking cost inside the cumulative budget. A semantic detector is a possible later experiment. Specialists adapt locally within their assignment and escalate shared premise changes.

First implement the simpler between-batch change. M1 Scheduler._committed_node checks a same-run frozen-plan proof. Importing an accepted result into another batch therefore needs a protected transfer that validates original artifact identity, check outcome, task scope, assumptions/dependency versions and authorized reads, without accepting arbitrary refs. Current declaration and qualified reviewer profile still own reviewer visibility.

If concurrency justifies live patches, propose against exact plan and knowledge revisions, validate atomically, reject stale proposals and cycles, and prevent stale dispatch. Permission revocation immediately blocks new prohibited dispatch and requests cancellation of affected work. Cancellation may not undo effects. An obsolete output remains historical evidence but cannot feed current descendants. Unknown dependency validity means conservative rerun or a visible block. Prompt cache identity alone is insufficient when datasets, policy or services changed.

Goal completion requires the fixed accepted objective criteria, not the producer's success field. Negative/inconclusive science can be accepted. The project stops or waits on supported completion, budget exhaustion, no progress or required input. Source: Sandbox Lab Design.md, How the loop works and Revising work without corrupting results.

Magentic-One https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/stable/user-guide/agentchat-user-guide/magentic-one.html supports separate task/progress ledgers and stalled-progress replanning. It does not prove AI4R quality or cost benefit. SyncPlan https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01652 motivates testing plan-staleness-triggered replanning in a different task setting. We do not transfer its performance results. Learning When to Plan https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.03581 is an additional cost-allocation reference.

Planned time 0:55. This is the proposed next delivery and decision. It prioritizes the research loop rather than a fleet or automatically generated ecosystem. Before coding, register the bounded slice through the target repository's current instructions and task allocation. First determine whether pinned upstream goal/replay components reduce integration work without weakening our protected checks. Then implement one changing-information journey using an actual planner. Qualify real job limits, stop, restart and independent backup/restore on the chosen host.

The comparison uses the same capabilities, model settings, task inputs, authorized data, discovery schedule, permissions, total budget and independent scoring across three planning policies. Freeze the quality rubric and acceptable cost/quality tradeoff before runs, including static-task quality protection. Include no-change tasks, scope changes, misleading observations, failed prerequisites and interruption. Repeat paired trials on held-out discovery cases. All attempts, failures and rejected outputs remain in the results. The budget includes planning, execution, review, repair and authoring where applicable; report preparation separately.

Useful selective adaptation should improve independently verified outcomes on changing-information tasks, preserve static-task quality and compare favorably with frequent replanning on cost at comparable quality. These are testable hypotheses, not outcomes. A single demonstration proves feasibility; an extended representative run is needed before a day-long reliability claim. Hardware transfer prediction quality and CC effectiveness have separate experimental controls.

Discussion decisions: first investigation boundary, completion rubric and cost limit, accepted-result transfer rule, and whether concurrency requires live patches after the first trial. Source: replacement Lab Capsule and Factory Design Plan.md and Sandbox Lab Design.md.

Backup. Coverage review includes user intent/permission authority, source of investigation inputs, proposed strategy, fixed execution identity, accepted output custody, reuse validity, interruption, stop and capability eligibility. Restore also needs independent verified backups, application-consistent checkpoints and old-writer fencing. A service volume does not imply a resumable simulator physics state. Credential loss or unavailable environment blocks only dependent work; never invent a success. Conflicting mutable sessions serialize through leases. Rejected candidate outputs and uncertain external effects cannot silently become accepted scientific evidence.
Source: Sandbox Lab Design.md. Every designed outcome needs actual implementation and evidence. This slide is not a test report.

October 26 M1 Reliability and ML Readiness Checkpoint records 319 controlled software checks and separate pending live scientific acceptance; that number is deliberately absent from the main talk because it does not prove this adaptive design. Current qualified review modes include historical output-only and opt-in evidence-aware review; this change preserves each selected profile rather than changing review payload authority.

The design is presentation-ready as a proposal, not specification-ready for arbitrary concurrent mutation. Open implementation decisions are explicit. No numerical benefit, complete research correctness, multi-lab deployment, malicious-code containment or day-long autonomy is established.
